question: Does an official NFL page publish player snap counts?
answer: no as a league table; yes as a per-game table inside the official Game Book PDF
evidence: https://www.nfl.com/stats/player-stats/ lists 11 categories and no snap-count category; https://www.nfl.com/stats/player-stats/category/snap-counts/2026/reg/all returns 404 - Flag on the Play. The official Game Book publishes a 'Playtime Percentage' table per game.
caveat: the Game Book captions that table '(Unofficial)'. It therefore cannot serve the brief's 'only from officially sourced numbers' rule as a certified count; it can serve as an NFL-published, dated, per-game participation measure that is labelled unofficial by its own publisher.

question: Does an official NFL page publish per-game inactive lists?
answer: yes: the official Game Book prints a 'Not Active' block for both clubs
evidence: 'Not Active' block read in all four Game Books captured here; 6 players per club.
caveat: the book is published after the game; it is a settlement record, not a pre-kickoff feed. For pre-kickoff certainty the 90-minute inactive list would be needed, and no official page for that list was located in this session.

question: Does the official Game Book name the actual starters?
answer: yes: a 'Lineups' block lists the 11 offensive and 11 defensive starters per club
evidence: Lineups block read in all four books; 22 starters per club per game.
caveat: the block is the book's own naming of who started; it is not a depth chart and does not carry a depth rank.

question: Does an official page publish a 2026 snap-count leaderboard?
evidence: snap-counts URL 404; the stats index enumerates its categories and snap counts is not one.
caveat: absence on the index is not proof the data does not exist somewhere on nfl.com; only that this session did not find an official 2026 snap-count leaderboard.

question: Does the official Week 10 injury report carry a game designation for both clubs in every game?
evidence: In the four games joined here, exactly 11 of 12 club blocks carry at least one non-empty Game Status cell; the Giants block carries none (11 rows, all blank).
caveat: only four games were read for this probe, so the finding is scoped to them.

question: Does the official Game Book publish stadium roof and surface?
answer: yes, as a text line: 'Open Stadium on Natural Grass' / 'Open Stadium on Field Turf'
caveat: the roof is the design, not the state at kickoff. Three of four books also carry measured game-day weather (temperature, humidity, wind, wind chill).
